source.body:
### Bug Description

When you rename a workflow from the editor header and clear the name, the empty field shows "Workflow name" as a placeholder. That placeholder is written in English directly in the code, so it does not get translated.

https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/367af9a941d705fcf4d66755fc972059250e19ee/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/app/components/MainHeader/WorkflowDetails.vue#L358

The rest of this flow is already translated. For example, if you try to save the empty name, the error toast uses `renameAction.emptyName.title`.

### To Reproduce

1. Set the UI to a language other than English.
2. Open any workflow.
3. Click the workflow name in the header and delete all of the text.
4. The empty field still says "Workflow name" in English.

### Expected behavior

The placeholder shows in the selected language.

### Debug Info

I found this while reading the code on `master` (2.46.0). The text is written into the code, so it happens on every setup.

### Environment

- Operating System: macOS (platform independent)
- n8n Version: 2.46.0 (`master`)
- Node.js Version: 24.x
- Database: n/a
- Execution mode: n/a

### Note

I have a fix ready and will open a PR.
